description: This file defines interfaces and factory for the IControlIpc component used for inter-process communication in the Rialto client, including methods for obtaining shared memory info and registering clients.

classes.name: IControlIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving the singleton instance of IControlIpc.

classes.name: IControlIpc
classes.description: Interface defining the control IPC APIs for communication with the Rialto server, including methods to get shared memory info and register clients.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a singleton instance of IControlIpcFactory.

methods.name: getControlIpc
methods.description: Returns the singleton IControlIpc instance, given a control client.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves shared memory file descriptor and size for mapping.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new client with the IPC.
